materialUpdates.summary: Expanded the recovery-only wiki into a detailed current-game freshness and qualification guide. Updated the verified official game baseline to Grim Dawn v1.3.0.5, added concrete v1.3.0.5 audit cases, immutable artifact recovery, browser/navigation/control verification, v3/v4/v5 localStorage migration testing, Content Freshness Manifest rules, domain-by-domain game-data auditing, exact contextual-link validation, offline behavior, full-data performance guardrails, troubleshooting, and release qualification gates.
